name: insert an image int the slide

steps.tooltip: Click the Insert tab to see options for adding content to your slide.
steps.explanation: The Insert tab contains all the tools needed to add various elements, including images, to your presentation.

steps.tooltip: Click Pictures to insert an image from your computer or online sources.
steps.explanation: This opens a menu allowing you to choose the source of the picture you wish to insert into your slide.

steps.tooltip: Select This Device to browse for an image stored on your computer.
steps.explanation: Choosing 'This Device' will open a file explorer window, letting you navigate to and select an image file from your local storage.

steps.tooltip: Navigate to your desired image, select it, and click Open to insert it.
steps.explanation: After selecting your image file, clicking 'Open' will place the image directly onto your current PowerPoint slide.
